captureMethod.representation: rendered Markdown text returned by the tool as the JSON-decoded 'content' string for the stated chunk; not HTML and not provider response bytes
captureMethod.transcription: Each file holds the tool-returned content string written as UTF-8. The tool result is not delivered to the sandbox filesystem, so transcription fidelity cannot be machine-verified against the tool output.
captureMethod.retrievalWindowBasis: NOT BRACKETED. This pass did not read the sandbox clock before and after each tool call, so no per-artifact window is claimed. All four retrievals occurred on 2026-10-24 between the session start and the manifest creation time above.

directSandboxRetrieval.evidence: From the sandbox, curl to https://www.bseindia.com/..., https://www.nseindia.com/..., https://www.sebi.gov.in/... and https://api.bseindia.com/... each returned 'curl: (35) OpenSSL SSL_connect: SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL' after DNS resolution succeeded (four hosts, 2026-10-24). The engine's own urllib transport failed identically (URLError: TLS/SSL connection has been closed (EOF)); see docs/investigation/PARAS-INGESTION-FAILURE-2026-10-23.md §15.2. So the engine cannot retrieve these documents from this sandbox, and the official-discovery provider correctly reports UNAVAILABLE rather than NOT_FOUND.

limitsOnReuse.admissibility: These captures are investigation evidence. They do not constitute a resolved issue term, a canonical record, a source approval or an evaluation input, and nothing here was written into the engine or any store.
limitsOnReuse.closedIssue: The BSE issue page is served under status=H (historical/closed). The engine's discovery contract deliberately follows only BSE records whose Status is F (forthcoming) or L (live) (engine/ipo_screening/official_issue_sources.py), so this page is NOT admissible to the engine as it stands. Recording it does not change that contract.
limitsOnReuse.mutable: The publisher pages are mutable, so re-fetching will not reproduce these files.
limitsOnReuse.thirdParty: Numerous third-party IPO aggregators publish the same 660-693 band and 21-share lot. None was used and none is retained: a snippet is not an official source and cannot supply an issue term.
